name: subagent-models
description: Turn subagent models on or off and set the effort subagents run at, as defaults in /config or live for one session with /subagent-models.

fable.title: Fable subagents
fable.description: on lets a subagent run on fable; off moves it to the default model

sonnet.title: Sonnet subagents
sonnet.description: on lets a subagent run on sonnet; off moves it to the default model

haiku.title: Haiku subagents
haiku.description: on lets a subagent run on haiku; off moves it to the default model

defaultModel.title: Default subagent model
defaultModel.description: The model a turned-off model moves to

effort.title: Subagent effort
effort.description: The effort every subagent request runs at; inherit keeps the request's own

offAction.title: When a spawn names a turned-off model
offAction.description: move runs it on the default model; deny refuses the spawn
